description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p data-start="0" data-end="44"><strong>We are hiring across multiple locations</strong></p> <p data-start="46" data-end="145"><strong data-start="46" data-end="56">India:</strong> Hyderabad, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru<br data-start="88" data-end="91"><strong data-start="91" data-end="102" data-is-only-node="">Europe:</strong> London, Serbia, Sofia, Lithuania, Berlin</p> <h3>ABOUT THE ROLE</h3> <p>Be at the forefront of the AI revolution, working on cutting-edge projects that shape the future of financial services. You’ll join a passionate team focused on building high-quality, scalable products with real-world impact.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer (AI) to bridge robust backend systems with Generative AI. You’ll design the frameworks, standards, and platforms that allow AI capabilities to scale securely, reliably, and efficiently across the enterprise, going beyond feature delivery to influence long-term technical direction.</p> <p><strong>As a Staff Engineer you’ll:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build core services for Tide’s agentic platform, including APIs, workflow&nbsp;orchestration, and tool integration&nbsp;</li> <li>Integrate bought components where they accelerate delivery, and build where&nbsp;control, trust, and reuse matter most</li> <li>Work with product, data, platform, and security teams to productionise shared AI&nbsp;capabilities</li> <li>Design services that are reliable, secure, observable, and easy for other teams to&nbsp;adopt</li> <li>Help shape reusable engineering patterns for AI-enabled workflows</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</h3> <ul> <li>Strong backend or platform engineering experience in production environments.</li> <li>Good judgement across APIs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and service design.</li> <li>Experience integrating internal and third-party platforms.</li> <li>Comfort working in ambiguity and turning emerging needs into robust platform components.</li> <li>Strong focus on quality, reliability, and developer usability.</li> <li>Experience with AI infrastructure or orchestration is helpful, but not essential.</li> <li>Experience in highly regulated industries (Fintech, Healthtech, etc.) where safety and compliance are core to the product is valuable, but not essential.</li> <li>Design and build automated evaluation pipelines to measure agent reasoning accuracy and safety trajectories</li> </ul> <h3>Our Tech Stack:</h3> <ul> <li>Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)</li> <li>Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable</li> <li>Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)</li> <li>Docker, Terraform, EKS used by the Cloud team to run the platform</li> <li>DataDog and Rollbar to keep it running</li> <li>GitHub with Sonarcloud, Semgrep and solid testing to power the CI/CD pipelines - new joiners are encouraged to have something deployed to production in their first 2 weeks</li> <li>Angular 2+ with ngrx on Web, Flutter for the Mobile App</li> <li>Fivetran/Snowflake/Looker for the BI insights and Python/Faust/Flask/Tecton + some ML libs for the automated decisioning and risk management</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. description: Zur EXARING AG Wir entwickeln und betreiben die TV-Plattform waipu.tv und sind Marktführer in Deutschland für unabhängiges IPTV. waipu.tv erreicht inzwischen über sechs Millionen Nutzer in Deutschland und erzielt mit Abstand die besten Kundenbewertungen im Markt. Neben klassischem Fernsehen bietet waipu.tv auch über 40.000 Filme und Serien auf Abruf. Unsere Kunden lieben die Flexibilität, mobil oder über das WLAN in allen Räumen und mit allen Geräten ihre Unterhaltung genießen zu können. Die Aufnahme-, Pause- und Restart-Funktion bietet zusätzlich eine Unabhängigkeit von starren Sendezeiten. Damit im Hintergrund alles reibungslos funktioniert, müssen Zahlungen verarbeitet, Abonnements verwaltet, Business-Partner abgerechnet, Betrugsversuche erkannt und aussagekräftige Reports erstellt werden. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Wir suchen keinen klassischen Finance-Experten. Wir suchen jemanden, der komplexe Prozesse versteht, gerne analytisch arbeitet und Spaß daran hat, gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklern intelligente Lösungen zu entwickeln. Wenn Du Geschäftsprozesse lieber neu denkst als verwaltest und Daten für Dich mehr sind als Tabellen, solltest Du weiterlesen. Deine Mission Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Technology und Data. Gemeinsam mit Finance, Business Intelligence, Engineering und unseren Softwarepartnern entwickelst Du unsere Business-Systeme rund um Payments und Revenue kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei sorgst Du dafür, dass Prozesse einfacher, intelligenter und stärker automatisiert werden und wir jederzeit auf verlässliche Daten und Kennzahlen vertrauen können. Das erwartet Dich Prozesse gestalten statt verwalten Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse, hinterfragst etablierte Abläufe und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen effizientere, skalierbare und automatisierte Lösungen. Business und Technologie verbinden Du verstehst fachliche Anforderungen, entwickelst daraus Lösungskonzepte und stimmst deren Umsetzung mit unseren Engineering-Teams und externen Softwarepartnern ab. Daten intelligent nutzen Gemeinsam mit unserem BI-Team entwickelst Du KPIs, Reports und Dashboards. Wenn Du Freude daran hast, erstellst Du Analysen auch selbst – beispielsweise mit BigQuery oder Tableau. Automatisierung vorantreiben Du identifizierst manuelle Abläufe, entwickelst Automatisierungskonzepte und begleitest deren Umsetzung. About you 

Required:

  • 3–5+ years of experience in software engineering, space systems engineering, satellite operations software, or ground segment development 

  • Strong experience building production-grade distributed systems, backend services, or mission-critical software 

  • Experience designing or working with mission planning, scheduling, automation, or orchestration systems in complex operational environments 

  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, Java, SQL, and containerised application development. 

  • Proven experience developing reliable, scalable software for production environments with a strong focus on correctness, robustness, and maintainability 

  • Familiarity with Linux environments and operating services in production (deployment, debugging, performance tuning) 

  • Experience with infrastructure components such as AWS, CI/CD pipelines, containerised deployments, and service orchestration

  • Ability to design and debug complex systems involving multiple services, data flows, and external operational dependencies 

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Imaging Operations, Flight Operations, product and engineering teams 

  • High level of ownership, autonomy, and attention to detail in mission- or safety-critical contexts 

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where systems evolve quickly, and operational reliability is essential 

Nice to Have: 

  • Prior exposure to satellite operations environments or ground segment toolchains; particularly satellite tasking, commanding, and on-board schedule (plan) generation.

  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Terramate) and automated configuration management using Ansible. 

  • Ability to build full-stack web applications with Next.js, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. 

  • Experience managing cloud infrastructure on AWS. 

  • Theoretical and applied background in AI planning and optimisation, including PDDL formulation, constraint satisfaction, Markov decision processes, and combinatorial optimisation algorithms.

description: Deine Rolle Unser Lagerführungssystem (LFS) ist das Herzstück unserer Business-Applikationen und das Rückgrat unseres operativen Geschäfts als Distributor und Fulfillment-Dienstleister. Für dieses wichtige System suchen wir eine zentrale Ansprechperson und Gestalter*in, die sowohl fachlich als auch systemisch Verantwortung übernimmt und das LFS aktiv weiterentwickelt. Du wirst Teil unseres Logistikteams und arbeitest genau an der Schnittstelle, an der Lager, ERP und Versand Hand in Hand zusammenarbeiten. Deine Verantwortung Du verantwortest unser Lagerführungssystem ganzheitlich: von der fachlichen Betreuung über die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung bis hin zum reibungslosen und stabilen Betrieb. Als Brücke zwischen Logistik und Softwareentwicklung verstehst du die Anforderungen der Logistik und wandelst sie in klare, umsetzbare Lösungen um. Du leitest die Weiterentwicklung des Systems, behältst dabei stets alle relevanten Datenflüsse und Schnittstellen zu angrenzenden Systemen im Blick. Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und führst gemeinsam mit den Fachabteilungen Verbesserungen durch. Du priorisierst Anforderungen, sorgst für Transparenz über den Status der Umsetzungen und dokumentierst dein Wissen strukturiert und nachvollziehbar. Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit unserem externen Systempartner und definierst dabei die Anforderungen klar und zielgerichtet. Du begleitest Anpassungen und Neuerungen von der Konzeption bis zum Testing und der Einführung – dabei holst du die Nutzer*innen aktiv mit ins Boot. Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft, hilfst unserem LFS-Support-Team bei der Lösung konkreter Probleme und packst dort mit an, wo es gebraucht wird. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung im Business Application Management, als IT-Consultant oder in einer ähnlichen Rolle mit fundiertem Systemverständnis. Ein gutes Verständnis von Lager- und Logistiksystemen sowie zugehörigen Prozessen wie Wareneingang, Kommissionierung, Bestandsführung und Versand. Sichere Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken und SQL-Abfragen. Ein feines Gespür für Datenflüsse und Schnittstellen, idealerweise im Zusammenspiel mit einem ERP-System. Die Fähigkeit, Anforderungen verständlich zwischen Fachbereich und Entwicklung zu vermitteln und klar zu strukturieren. Analytisches Denkvermögen und Freude daran, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen und pragmatische Lösungen zu finden. Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Dienstleister. Kenntnisse in Anforderungs- und Projektdokumentationstools wie Jira und Confluence sind von Vorteil. Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise gepaart mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität. Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Beteiligte auf gemeinsame Ziele einzuschwören. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Bei uns zählen Persönlichkeit und Können gleichermaßen. Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und mit Begeisterung Dinge besser machen will. Das kannst du bei uns erwarten Ein lockeres und respektvolles Miteinander – wir duzen uns! Über 20 Nationalitäten und viele Sprachen – ein vielfältiges, offenes Team. Unsere Feel-Good-Manager auf vier Pfoten: Amigo, Pelle und Donna sorgen für gute Stimmung. Hybrides Arbeiten mit flexibler Büropräsenz. Zentral gelegen mit nur 5 Minuten Fußweg zur S-Bahn Eidelstedt und kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt vor der Tür. Leckeres Essen zu kleinen Preisen in unserer Kantine mit eigenem Koch. 30 Tage Urlaub basierend auf einer 5-Tage-Woche. Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge. Deutschlandticket-Zuschuss. Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und attraktive Entwicklungschancen. Moderne Standorte von Hamburg bis Wittenburg mit topaktueller Technik. description: <h1>Senior Director of Product, Engagement (f/m/x)</h1> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>HelloFresh has spent nearly fifteen years perfecting the home cooking experience, and is now extending that expertise beyond the weekly meal kit to become a daily kitchen companion for any home cook — from the first scroll of inspiration to the moment you plate your meal. You will lead <strong>the Engagement tribe</strong>, which focuses on deepening customers' relationships with our brands, is the driving force behind this shift. It's a highly visible mandate with sustained attention from senior leadership.</p> <p>The tribe's work spans three connected domains, each driving a distinct part of our growth engine. For the daily<em> Discovery and Cooking Experience</em>, our goal is habit formation. We are building a large, top-of-funnel audience by ensuring the HelloFresh app supports users through every step of getting a weeknight dinner on the table, regardless of whether they're ordering our meal kits. title: CRM Manager:in (w/m/div), in Vollzeit, in Berlin, ab sofort
description: Du willst deine Leidenschaft für CRM und Kundenbindung in einem Unternehmen ausleben, für dessen Vision du brennst? DR. VIVIEN KARL ist ein junges, schnell wachsendes Berliner Startup, das den Markt der Intimpflege mit natürlichen, wissenschaftsbasierten und ästhetischen Produkten aufmischt. Der Bestandskundenbereich ist einer der wichtigsten Bereiche in unserem Unternehmen – und genau hier wollen wir in den kommenden Jahren enorm wachsen. Entsprechend groß ist die Verantwortung und der Anspruch bei dieser Rolle: Wir suchen eine erfahrene CRM-Persönlichkeit, die unser CRM eigenverantwortlich führt – strategisch denkt, tief in den Zahlen steckt und trotzdem selbst E-Mails und Kampagnen operativ umsetzt. Du führst eine Werkstudentin und gestaltest maßgeblich, wie wir mit unseren Kundinnen kommunizieren. Aufgaben Du verantwortest unser CRM End-to-End: Strategie, operative Umsetzung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung über all unsere Owned-Channels (E-Mail, WhatsApp, Print-Mailings). Du baust, testest und optimierst unsere Lifecycle-Flows entlang der gesamten Kundinnenreise (u. a. Cross-Sell, Replenishment, Winback) und hebst so systematisch Kundenbindung und Customer Lifetime Value. Du entwickelst zielgruppenspezifische Kampagnen und Newsletter von der Idee bis zum Versand: Konzept, Copy, technische Umsetzung und A/B-Testing – hands-on in Klaviyo. Du steuerst unsere Segmentierung auf Basis von Verhaltens- und Transaktionsdaten (u. a. RFM) und erkennst das ungenutzte Potenzial einzelner Segmente, quantifizierst es und entwickelst proaktiv neue Kampagnen-Ideen, um sie zu reaktivieren und zum Wiederkauf zu bewegen Du machst Performance messbar: Du baust Reportings und Analysen zu Kohorten, Churn und CLV/CAC und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Du führst und entwickelst deine Werkstudentin: Du verteilst Aufgaben klar, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und baust das Team perspektivisch weiter auf. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Performance-Marketing Team und den Gründerinnen zusammen und spielst deine Erkenntnisse aktiv ins Team zurück. Qualifikation Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (BWL, Marketing o. ä.) und mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im CRM-, Lifecycle- oder Retention-Marketing, idealerweise in einem D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld. Du kennst Klaviyo und Shopify aus dem Effeff – Flows, Segmentierung, dynamische Inhalte, A/B-Tests, Deliverability und Reporting. Du denkst analytisch, hast eine echte Affinität für Zahlen und übersetzt Daten souverän in Entscheidungen; Kohorten-, Retention- und CLV-Analysen sind für dich Alltag. Du bist genauso strategisch wie hands-on: Du entwickelst die Roadmap und setzt sie am nächsten Tag selbst um. Du arbeitest routiniert mit KI und hast den hohen Anspruch, all deine operativen, sich wiederholenden Prozesse zu automatisieren. Du bist ein Kommunikations- und Schreibtalent, liebst die deutsche Grammatik und schreibst Copy, die konvertiert. Du bringst Ambition, echten Drive, unternehmerisches Denken und ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein für deine Themen mit. Erste Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert, selbstständig und passt dich mit einer „Can Do"-Mentalität schnell an ein wachsendes Umfeld an. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C2-Niveau). Benefits Du verantwortest das CRM eigenständig und führst dein eigenes Team – vom ersten Tag an mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum. Ein dynamisches, schnelles Umfeld, in dem deine Arbeit direkt auf Umsatz und Kundenbindung einzahlt. Ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit offener Feedbackkultur und direktem Austausch. Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründerinnen beeinflusst du maßgeblich die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens. Du bist Teil eines jungen Startup-Teams, wo Spaß genauso wichtig ist wie Leistung und gemeinsames Lernen. Eine zeitlich flexible und ortsunabhängige Arbeitsweise (Hauptwohnort Berlin). Eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft. Für uns ist es wichtig, dass du in Berlin wohnst. Wir haben dich überzeugt und du möchtest Teil unserer Mission werden? Dann überzeuge uns und schicke deinen Lebenslauf, dein mögliches Startdatum und deine Gehaltsvorstellung. Wir freuen uns auf dich! With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h2>About the team&nbsp;</h2> <p>The Admin Services commercial team are responsible for driving adoption and usage of essential products for Small Business Owners.&nbsp; This includes Tide’s range of accounting packages, as well as invoicing, expense management, payroll and Company Formations / Company Secretariat services.&nbsp; Most of these are sold on a subscription basis, providing consistent value to members and a consistent revenue stream to Tide. &nbsp; The team works closely with Product, Finance, Business Insights, CRM and Operations teams to translate member and commercial insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, and strategies that enhance engagement and retention.&nbsp;</p> <h2>About the role<strong>&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Country Commercial Manager to drive revenue growth from our Invoicing and Expense Management products, as well as leading on our Accountant GTM. You will sit at the heart of Tide’s commercial function, and be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand product performance, uncover opportunities, and work across multiple areas to deliver.&nbsp; This will require a relentless focus on the numbers and our members, product prioritisation, and detailed planning to ensure revenue targets are hit and customer lifetime value is always increasing.<br><br>In this role, you will be responsible for the strategy and implementation of core activities to drive activation and usage of Invoicing and Expense Management as well as unlocking growth out of Accountants. This includes close partnership with marketing teams to ensure seamless delivery of ‘always on’ campaign activity.&nbsp; This role will also own the strategy and launch approach for new product launches, ensuring that all channels and member touch points are considered.&nbsp; This includes end-to-end journeys and transaction channels.&nbsp; You’ll need to partner effectively with multiple stakeholders to make this happen – excellent organisation and communication skills essential.</p> <p><strong>Some of the things you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Revenue Ownership &amp; Forecasting</strong>: Partner closely with Finance and key stakeholders to set, track, and refine financial projections for Invoicing, Expense Management and Accountants, ensuring revenue accountability and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Analytics-Driven Insight: </strong>with the support of the BI team you will analyse member behaviour, segment audiences, and measure subscription cohort&nbsp; performance. You will then translate this data into clear recommendations that shape product prioritisation, pricing, positioning and communications.</li> <li><strong>Product Development: </strong>Leveraging the commercial and analytics insights, you will partner with the Product teams to address areas of opportunity.&nbsp; This will include shaping product positioning, product led growth, aligning on roadmaps and supporting&nbsp; successful product launches with tailored GTM strategies.</li> <li><strong>Launch Strategy</strong>: &nbsp; You’ll support new feature launches across channels, partnering with excellent sales, and operations teams to deliver best-in-class experiments.&nbsp; You’ll facilitate brainstorm sessions / workshops to surface creative ideas and implementation plans.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Management:&nbsp; </strong>As you’ll be working in a highly collaborative way, it will be key to communicate regularly with a wide range of stakeholders.&nbsp; This will include Tide’s Senior Leadership Team as well as the C-Suite.</li> <li><strong>Commercial &amp; Competitor Intelligence:</strong> Lead ongoing commercial research and competitive analysis to monitor trends, and benchmark to translate it into actionable strategies that strengthen and differentiate Tide’s positioning and value proposition.</li> <li><strong>Member Obsession:</strong> You will be or become an expert in the core motivations of our members in order to focus on bringing their voice to commercial and product design discussions.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strong commercial acumen</strong>:&nbsp; Achievers offers more than just a thank you program. Our employee recognition and rewards software inspires employees to recognize everyone, every day, everywhere. With 4.3 million global users, we empower employees across 190 countries. Visit us at achievers.com to learn more and check out our platform in action. Join our team of A-players who bring passion to our purpose and believe that meaningful change creates extraordinary outcomes — together, we’ll inspire recognition everywhere and achieve results that matter. 

Our commitment to you:
At Achievers, we hire you for you because we value the unique perspective and individuality that each person brings to our team. We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace where you belong, and your contributions are celebrated. Together, we achieve more by combining our unique strengths, fostering collaboration, and inspiring each other to reach new heights. 

The opportunity:

As a Senior Sales Development Representative (Sr. SDR), you will play a critical role in driving pipeline generation and revenue growth across the EMEA region. Building upon core sales development expertise, you will own strategic prospecting initiatives, develop targeted account penetration strategies, and partner closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to create qualified opportunities within enterprise and mid-market organisations.
 
You will also serve as a role model and mentor to newer SDRs, sharing best practices and helping elevate overall team performance.

How you will shape sales development at Achievers:
  • Generate qualified sales opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting across assigned EMEA territories.
  • Conduct research and account mapping to identify key decision-makers, influencers, and buying committees within target organisations.
  • Build relationships with multiple stakeholders across prospective accounts to increase account penetration and create new business opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Account Executives to develop account strategies, progress opportunities, and drive pipeline growth.
  • Create and execute targeted outreach campaigns leveraging phone, email, social selling, and other prospecting channels.
  • Maintain accurate accounts, opportunities, and activity data within Salesforce and other sales engagement platforms.
  • Stay informed on EMEA market trends, competitive activity, and industry developments to enhance prospecting effectiveness and account strategies.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed pipeline generation, meeting creation, and activity targets.
  • Share best practices and provide guidance to less experienced SDR team members, contributing to overall team success.
  • Demonstrate a multithreading approach into large key accounts.
  • Outline using AI to streamline prospecting
  • Process and create efficiencies in workflow

    • Experience we feel will set you up for success:
  • 18+ months of experience in a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Business Development Representative (BDR), or similar prospecting role with a track record of achieving or exceeding targets.
  • Strong understanding of outbound prospecting and lead qualifications.
  • Proven ability to engage and build relationships with stakeholders at multiple levels within an organisation.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively.
  • Experience using CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and sales engagement tools such as Outreach, Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar technologies.
  • Strong organisational, prioritisation, and time management skills.
  • Results-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Experience prospecting within the EMEA market and an understanding of regional business practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to share best practices and positively contribute to team performance and culture.

    • Why join our team:
  • Join a team of high-performance consistent 100%+ quota teammates
  • Additional holiday allowance on top of statutory days which we call ‘Achievers Reward Days’.
  • Team lunches and global company updates which means a chance for collaboration and connection outside of your day-to-day
  • Pension, Life Assurance, Private Medical + Wellbeing benefits
  • Technology & Cycle Scheme
  • Buy up to 5 days extra holiday each year
  • Hybrid working culture
  • 2 volunteering/community activity days per year
    • Why you’ll love working at Achievers:
    ✨ We are passionate about disruptive technology that’s rooted in science, research and data.
    ✨ We understand the value of employee success in the workplace and have been recognized in numerous publications for our contributions to HR, for technical excellence, and for our outstanding workplace culture!
    ✨ We foster an environment of connection, security, and community. You’ll feel at home, without reservation. 
    ✨ We believe in moving quickly, failing fast, and adapting to change. 
    ✨ We enjoy coming to work every day because we believe in our product and love our culture.
    ✨ We’re committed to achieving excellence in everything we do. 

    Our work environment:
    Achievers is a hybrid-first company located at 99 Atlantic Ave in Liberty Village, Toronto. Our hybrid work experience is designed to cultivate an engaging employee experience, where pioneering research intersects with cutting-edge technology. We strongly believe that collocating teams increases the chance to innovate together, foster passive learning, create spontaneous connections, and promote better communication.

    Achievers does not offer employment to prospects without first ensuring that qualified candidates speak directly with the hiring manager and a member of our HR team. All qualification will be done face-to-face, whether that is in person or over Zoom. Achievers does not send out offers of employment without meeting candidates and does not offer employment via text. If you are requested for any personal information via text and/or without having met a member of our hiring team in person, please disregard.

    Our employees are a diverse and inclusive team of passionate, hardworking individuals. Achievers is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an environment where our employees can do the best work of their lives. We encourage all qualified candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to apply to join our A-Player family.  

    Achievers is committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. title: Senior Grab Crane Operative, Smugglers Way MRF
description: Step into a vital position at our Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) in Smugglers Way, Wandsworth. This is a fast‑paced, hands‑on operational role at the heart of London’s recycling system. Every day, you’ll be helping turn thousands of tonnes of commingled recyclables into high‑quality materials ready for reprocessing — ensuring that the city’s waste is handled safely, efficiently, and sustainably. As a Senior Grab Crane Operative, you’ll take ownership of managing and maintaining bunker levels, coordinating material arriving by dustcart for processing in the MRF. You’ll be the go‑to person for overseeing junior and agency operatives, giving direction, offering guidance, and ensuring everyone works to the highest safety and operational standards. You’ll also play a key role in liaising with TAC Control, Shift Supervisors and sampling teams to keep material quality high and operations flowing smoothly. Effective communication and calm decision‑making will be essential, especially in a busy environment where no two days look the same. This role also brings opportunities to contribute to wider operational planning — from resource allocation and maintenance coordination to supporting the smooth running of the site. You’ll be central to maintaining a safe, organised and high‑performing facility that helps keep London’s recycling moving. Please note: This role is Monday to Friday, 14:00 to 22:00. We’re looking for someone with experience in a similar environment — preferably within recycling, MRF operations or an engineering‑based setting. You should be comfortable making decisions in a high‑pressure operational setting, with a strong understanding of safe working practices and statutory requirements. Being a team player is essential. You’ll be guiding junior operatives, supporting colleagues across the facility, and ensuring that daily check sheets, paperwork and handovers are completed clearly and on time. Strong communication skills will help you keep everything running smoothly. You’ll need the willingness to work flexibly, including additional hours or alternative shifts as required. A practical mindset, hands‑on attitude and readiness to assist with wider site tasks — including cleaning and maintenance duties — will make you a great fit. If you’re driven, reliable and motivated by making a difference in essential environmental operations, you’ll thrive in this role and become a valued part of an experienced and dedicated team. Ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across releases.</li> <li>Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, rendering issues, or compatibility problems — and propose robust architectural or design solutions.</li> </ul> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong data-stringify-type="bold">An ideal candidate should have</strong></div> <p><strong>Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C++, Win32/WinRT/COM).</li> <li>Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code.</li> <li>Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production-quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability.</li> <li>Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software.</li> <li>Excellent software engineering fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, memory management, multi-threading or asynchronous programming (where relevant).</li> <li>Experience leading technical design, mentoring other engineers, conducting code reviews, and making architecture-level decisions.</li> <li>Strong communication skills; ability to articulate tradeoffs, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive consensus.</li> <li>A user-centric mindset: focus on building polished, intuitive, and accessible experiences for end users.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred / Bonus:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with writing automated tests for UI — unit tests, integration tests, UI automation tests; familiarity with relevant testing frameworks.</li> <li>Experience with performance optimization for desktop apps (memory usage, startup time, rendering performance, high-DPI support, responsiveness under load).</li> <li>Experience with localization/globalization, right-to-left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions.</li> <li>Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications.</li> <li>Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to take ownership of feature areas or modules and drive them long-term, including maintenance, refactoring, and technical debt management.</li> </ul> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">What we offer</strong></p> <ul> <li>A high-impact role: you will define architecture, shape the future of our Windows product, and directly influence what millions of users see and experience.</li> <li>A collaborative, flat-structure engineering culture — you are not just a coder, but a builder and a decision-maker.</li> <li>Opportunities to lead — mentor others, steer technical direction, and grow into broader technical leadership (e.g. Tech Lead, Architect).</li> <li>Flexibility, autonomy, and responsibility: you define how to solve problems, own features end-to-end, and contribute to long-term product vision.</li> <li>A purpose-driven mission: building software that’s reliable, accessible, and user-centered — making a real difference for people.&nbsp; About Us
Canary Technologies is changing the game for hotels with modern software powered by Canary's hospitality-specific AI platform.
 
Canary is utilized by 20,000+ hoteliers in 100+ countries to equip hoteliers with the technology they need to work smarter and wow their guests. Major hotel brands such as Wyndham, Marriott, IHG, Four Seasons, Rosewood, and Best Western trust Canary to deliver results.
 
Canary was named a 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, a Most Innovative Company by Fast Company and a HotelTechReport Best Place to Work — and is backed by top Silicon Valley investors like Y Combinator, F-Prime, Brighton Park Capital and Insight Partners.
 
Join us in shaping the future of hospitality!
 

About the Role

Canary is at the forefront of providing AI-powered technology solutions to the hospitality industry. Our mission is to help hotels modernize operations, enhance guest experiences, and drive business results through intuitive, digital-first products. Our innovative platform is trusted by hotels worldwide for its ability to streamline operations and improve guest satisfaction.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our growing team and help lead the development of impactful products across key areas of our platform. In this role, you’ll take ownership of complex problem spaces, work closely with cross-functional partners, and drive initiatives that are critical to Canary’s continued growth and customer success.

You’ll have the opportunity to work on a variety of high-leverage product areas, such as:

  • Guest communication
  • Digital check-in
  • Payments
  • Upsells
  • And more!

As part of a globally distributed team, you’ll collaborate regularly with colleagues and customers across time zones—so flexibility, asynchronous communication, and strong cross-cultural collaboration skills are essential.

If you are a strong product thinker with at least 5 years of product management experience, and you’re excited to help shape the future of hospitality tech, we’d love to connect.


Responsibilities
  • Define and execute product strategy, roadmap, and delivery plans for the Canary platform.
  • Partner with Engineering and Design teams to bring intuitive, scalable, and reliable features to life.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure successful product launches and strong customer adoption.
  • Conduct in-depth customer research and product analysis to inform prioritization and uncover new opportunities.
  • Translate complex customer and business needs into clear product requirements and user stories.
  • Set clear goals and success metrics, and use data to drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Help mentor product managers and contribute to the broader product culture and processes.

    • Qualifications
  • 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or a technology-driven environment.
  • Proven ability to define and ship successful products that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong product intuition and customer empathy—you understand how to solve real problems with elegant, user-focused solutions.
  • Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams to drive execution in an agile environment.
  • Skilled at making data-informed decisions while remaining grounded in customer feedback.
  • Comfortable operating in a high-growth, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across time zones within globally distributed teams.
  • Bonus: Experience in hospitality technology, messaging platforms, payments, or AI/ automation is a plus.

    • EU Compensation

    Target cash compensation ranges from €140,000 - €175,000, including a fixed annual salary and a performance-based bonus paid quarterly.

    This role also includes a stock option grant, subject to board approval.

    Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's skill level, experience, and specific work location.

    We also work hard to ensure Canary is a fun and exciting place to work! Here are some of the additional benefits:
     
    Canary Days:  As a company we want to ensure that the team has time to recharge. Each month we provide company wide days off to ensure there is at least one extended weekend or day off.
     
    Self Improvement Club: We meet each month and share our personal goals for the month. Each individual is provided a budget towards any purchases that help us achieve these goals.
     
    Professional Development Chats: We provide budget to help drive cross functional professional development conversations across the organization.
     
    Travel Reimbursement: Team members are able to visit our offices across New York, San Francisco or Dallas when they choose, and are provided a travel stipend for doing so.  Spend time working with the team in their office, and use the rest of your time exploring a new city!
     
    Personal Travel Reimbursement: If you stay at a hotel that Canary works with, we provide a credit towards your stay.
     
    Canary Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. About Kuoni Tumlare

At Kuoni Tumlare, we design and deliver exceptional travel experiences through a comprehensive portfolio of destination management solutions. With over 100 years of expertise, we serve a global network of partners by offering series tours, educational trips, MICE events, guaranteed departure tours, and more. Our marketplace strategy is at the forefront of digital transformation, ensuring a competitive edge in a rapidly evolving travel landscape

The Job:

We are looking for a person with Travel and Tourism industry experience to join our new Business Quality Assurance team and help us elevate the quality of our products to the next level. We are seeking someone who would be keen to learn modern web technologies and software testing skills and is passionate about quality, reliability, and efficiency.

As a Business QA Engineer, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining automated test suites for End-to-End processes, giving demonstrations to stakeholders and coordinating User Acceptance Testing.

Responsibilities

• Continuously improve test quality and reliability from a business perspective

• Analyse test results, identify root causes, and collaborate with product teams to resolve issues

• Validate workflows with a business-focus to confirm the solution meets business needs

• Provide clear and concise demonstrations to stakeholders

• Ensure that the UAT environment, data, and processes accurately reflect production conditions

• Prepare, coordinate, support User Acceptance Testing and manage issues based on business impact

• Actively identify opportunities to optimize testing processes and improve efficiency

• Learn and work with Playwright or Cypress (and other modern automation tools)

• Manage automated tests (UI, API, integration, end-to-end)


• 3+ years of business/UAT QA experience with a strong understanding of business processes.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

• Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a quality-first mindset

• Show awareness of the system structure to diagnose issues

• Self-driven, proactive, and able to take ownership of product quality

• Demonstrate agility in learning and applying new technologies.

Nice to Have

• Experience in Tour Operations or Destination Management

• Experience in software testing, ideally in a web-based environment

What We Offer:

  • Global Brand: Opportunity to work in an international environment spread across 33 countries and growing.

  • Stability: 100 Years at the top of our field and still pushing into new territory

  • Progression: We reward high performers and look to promote key talent internally

  • Learning and Development opportunities for growth and Upskilling

  • A Supportive Management Culture and autonomous working environment

  • Company Wide Bonus Scheme

  • Dedicated Employee Engagement Activities

  • Flexible & Hybrid Working

  • Annual Awards and Recognition for high Performers

  • Friendly and Collaborative work environment
